timestamp_precision: Minute-level observation time from the research run; no independent timestamp anchor.

source_capture_policy.admission_rule: Keep outside the feature store until exact issuer-file bytes, SHA-256 receipts, per-fund identifiers, source publication timestamps and synchronized fund-universe masks are captured.

source_registry.source_lineage: Issuer-published holdings pages/files scraped by XRP Insights; holdings deltas calculated by XRP Insights.
source_registry.raw_capture_status: web-rendered JSON metadata excerpt; original HTTP bytes not captured
limitations: Flows are computed from issuer-reported XRP holdings deltas, not issuer-reported USD cash creations/redemptions.
GXRP holdings are included but its daily flow is withheld because an automated-read gap caused a freeze and catch-up.
XRPR includes exposure held through another XRP exchange-traded product; its reported direct holdings are not the full economic exposure.
BITW is a diversified index fund; its XRP sleeve can change through index rebalancing.
Historical rows include reconstructed days and the latest 4 November row remains provisional.
Flow-excluded funds contribute zero to the displayed aggregate.

source_registry.source_lineage: Issuer-published holdings files scraped by CryptoKeyhole; holdings deltas calculated by CryptoKeyhole.
source_registry.raw_capture_status: web-rendered page only; original issuer-file bytes not captured
limitations: Daily totals include four spot funds only: Bitwise XRP, Franklin XRPZ, Canary XRPC and 21Shares TOXR.
GXRP is not collected daily; the page displays its June 30 SEC filing quantity separately.
XRPR is excluded because its daily file reports direct XRP only while part of its exposure is through another ETP.
BITW is excluded as a diversified index fund.
The 4 November row is partial because Franklin Templeton had not yet published; it must not be treated as a complete daily flow.
CryptoKeyhole uses its own XRP/USD close for USD valuation.

interpretation: The -194,875 XRP and -6,678 XRP two-day totals are not measurements of the same fund universe. XRP Insights includes XRPR and BITW; CryptoKeyhole excludes both. Both withhold GXRP daily flows.
The exact -188,197 XRP difference is not attributed to XRPR or BITW: synchronized per-fund issuer files and byte-complete receipts were not captured.
The 119,592,749 XRP displayed holdings difference is mostly explained by the additional GXRP, XRPR and BITW quantities shown by XRP Insights; an 18,141 XRP residual remains unreconciled.

Both aggregators derive flow from issuer-reported holdings changes. Those changes can include fees, index rebalancing, indirect ETP exposure and timing effects; they are not equivalent to verified USD cash creations or redemptions.
The aggregators use the same underlying issuer source family and therefore are separate calculation pipelines, not independent primary-source corroboration.
The 4 November XRP Insights row is provisional; CryptoKeyhole's 4 November row is partial at 3 of 4 funds. Neither is a complete 4 November flow observation.
The latest disagreement is a data-universe and source-vintage problem, not evidence of a directional XRP signal.

predictive_admission.recommended_feature_design: Store per-fund holdings, computed holdings delta, source publication time, row settlement status, direct-versus-indirect exposure, inclusion mask and issuer-file receipt separately. Calculate aggregates only over an explicitly versioned common fund universe.
required_quality_gates: Exact issuer-file byte capture and SHA-256 receipt for every fund/day.
Publication and retrieval timestamps distinct from the holdings effective date.
Per-fund missing, excluded, reconstructed and provisional states preserved.
Direct XRP holdings separated from indirect ETP exposure and diversified index sleeves.
Cash creation/redemption records kept separate from holdings deltas.

next_actions: Capture primary issuer holdings files independently for all funds and retain the exact bytes.
Reconcile fund-by-fund holdings against SEC filings at each quarter end.
Do not use either aggregate flow series as a standalone XRP directional feature.
Keep all rendered aggregate observations outside the predictive feature store.
